verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm an llms.txt at docs.claude.com/llms.txt. The Claude Code overview is also served as raw markdown (.md), and that page points agents to a dedicated documentation index at code.claude.com/docs/llms.txt; other doc pages such as mcp.md and sandboxing.md are likewise served as .md, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: first-party guidance explaining how to use llms.txt or the .md docs with agents, independent community corroboration, and full probe content (the snippets are truncated).
